description: Defines the abstract class rx::TextureStorage11 and its derived classes for managing D3D11 textures, including 2D, cube, 3D, array, multisample, and external textures, with support for features like mipmaps, swizzling, and associated images.

classes.name: TextureStorage11
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D11 texture storage, providing interface for texture operations.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_2D
classes.description: Concrete class for 2D textures, including swapchain and regular textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_Cube
classes.description: Concrete class for cube map textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_2DMultisampleArray
classes.description: Concrete class for multisample 2D array textures.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_External
classes.description: Concrete class for external textures (e.g., EGL images).

classes.name: TextureStorage11ImmutableBase
classes.description: Base class for immutable texture storage where associated images do not change.

classes.name: TextureStorage11_EGLImage
classes.description: Concrete class for EGL image textures.

methods.name: getMippedResource
methods.description: Returns a mipmapped version of the resource if available.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Gets the render target view for a specific image index.

methods.name: associateImage
methods.description: Associates an Image11 object with the texture storage.

methods.name: disassociateImage
methods.description: Disassociates an Image11 object from the texture storage.

methods.name: releaseAssociatedImage
methods.description: Releases the associated image, possibly due to destruction or reinitialization.

methods.name: createSRVForSampler
methods.description: Creates a shader resource view for sampling.

methods.name: createSRVForImage
methods.description: Creates a shader resource view for an image.

methods.name: createUAVForImage
methods.description: Creates an unordered access view for an image.
